# Original static-image fixtures

Generated by `node tools/static/generate-fixtures.mjs` using the installed Edge
canvas encoders. No downloaded artwork or additional package is involved. The
original four-quadrant artwork (red/green/blue/yellow, 40×20 pixels) is dedicated
to the public domain under CC0-1.0, like the repository's other original fixtures.
Encoder bytes can differ across browser versions; the pixels and test semantics
are reproducible.

`quadrants.jpg`, `.png` and `.webp` encode the same original pixels. JPEG is lossy;
tests sample the center of each region with tolerance. `orientation-2/3/6/8.jpg`
inject a minimal EXIF Orientation APP1 entry into the original JPEG: mirrored,
180°, 90° clockwise and 90° counterclockwise. Browser `createImageBitmap` with
`imageOrientation: 'from-image'` must apply these transforms; 6/8 return 20×40.
The application only inspects JPEG SOF dimensions and does not parse EXIF itself.
`corrupt.jpg` is a deliberately truncated SOF marker for error recovery tests.
